title: Gwangju Nam-gu Campus Opening
excerpt: Our Honam-region hub, the Gwangju Nam-gu campus, opens.
body: Hanbit opens a new preschool & kindergarten campus in Nam-gu, Gwangju, bringing inquiry-led STEM early education to families in the Honam region.

title: 2027 Admissions Now Open
excerpt: Applications for the 2027 school year are open across all campuses.
body: We are accepting applications from preschool to secondary for 2027. Information session dates are on the Events page.

title: STEAM Fair 2026
excerpt: Student science and engineering projects, all in one place.
body: Our annual STEAM Fair returns this year, with students exhibiting and presenting projects they designed and built.

title: Cambridge IGCSE Introduced
excerpt: We now run the world-recognised Cambridge international curriculum.
body: We have introduced the Cambridge IGCSE programme in secondary, strengthening the path to higher study.
